name: Highly Casual | 5mg Seltzer | Blueberry + Pineapple 1:1
description:
Ever mixed blueberries and pineapples together? Not recently? Well, you’re in luck, because our Blueberry + Pineapple seltzer is the Highly Casual Wildcard.

It’s fresh. It’s got zip. It tastes just like that energy drink you like, without all the weird stuff inside. Our Blueberry + Pineapple just has great tasting fruit flavor, seltzer, and weed. There might be more ingredients than that, but you get where we’re going.
